procedural_matters: International jury upon receipt of a report from the Organizing Authority, decided to call a hearing under RRS 62.1
Competitors supported by Marijan Pamuklio (reg. 592) who attended the hearing is MNE 222865 – Nikola Golabaviá.
The OA was represented by Jan-Ole Scholgz.
Video evidence was presented by the OA.
facts: The speed limit is posted in the entrance of the marina – 3 Knots.
Marijan Pamuklio (coach) was aware of the speed limit
Marijan Pamuklio was motoring and towing at a speed higher than 3 knots inside the Marina
Marijan Pamuklio followed other not identified coach boats at similar speed
conclusions: Marijan Pamuklio was found motoring inside the Marina at a speed higher than 3 knots and broke Event Support Team Regulation 3.6 and NoR 14.3.
decision: Marijan Pamuklio shall apologize in writing to the OA.
